newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach eases after broker downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach eases after broker downgrade.

text.p: Shares in British bus and train operator Stagecoach Holdings edged lower on Thursday after NatWest security downgraded its recommendation on the company to "hold" from "add", market sources said.
The downgrade comes after a strong run in Stagecoach shares which have risen 328-1/2p or 131 percent over the past 12 months.
The stock was trading 1p lower at 578-1/2p by mid-morning.
"There's no change in NatWest forecasts. It's on a valuation basis and they think its time for the shares to have a breather," said one market source.
NatWest analysts were not immediately available to comment.
